body: ac-01 gate signed 2026-06-10: author approved the sizing memo as amended ('Approve as written') — 1,400 columns (9x90 battleground / 7x50 model-gap / 4x60 backbone), >=10pp detection target, adjudication cap 350 columns, ~30% external vendored+registered, GeoNames/CLDR lens-only under the decisive-lens rule. Review questions answered before signature: lineage (card-0018 registry chain) and GeoNames/CLDR exclusion rationale — see sizing_memo.md sections added 2026-06-10.

ac-02 progress 2026-06-10: GitTables share BUILT — scripts/build_gold_corpus_candidates.py draws 1,148 candidates deterministically (md5-order, seed-free) from v19_gated.parquet into eval/gold/gold_corpus_candidates.tsv; + 240 anchor seeds = 1,388/1,400. Two buckets per contested type (header_pos for recall, model_emit for FP-hunting), per-header cap 5, header-length<=64 and __index_level screens, no raw values in the fixture (anchor sanitisation convention). Backbone draws skip the is_trivial filter (the flag marks plain numeric/text wholesale — that IS the backbone population). Only hard shortfall: top_level_domain 12 cols. External share (~150-180 cols, BELOW the memo's ~30% aspiration — recorded deviation: GitTables filled every quota, external targets information not volume) is planned source-by-source with licences in eval/gold/gold_corpus_external_plan.md; fetch+register+draw is the next work item, then ac-03 lenses. ac-02 stays unchecked until external lands.

ac-02 external share executed 2026-06-10: 10 open datasets fetched, PII-screened (name columns stripped from NYC payroll/DOB, SF businesses before vendoring — repo is PUBLIC), vendored under eval/datasets/gold_external/ (~30MB), registered via dataset_register.py with NEW role=gold (added to the tool's choices), snapshots in eval/datasets/snapshots/gold-*.json. scripts/build_gold_corpus_external.py extracts 123 columns across all 18 strata incl. real utc offsets (OpenFlights), ISO country codes (OurAirports), UK postcodes + GBP amounts (HM Land Registry OGL-3.0), boundary cases by design (bare domains as url candidates, state-plane coords as lat/lon near-misses). Corpus total: 1,148 GitTables + 240 anchor + 123 external = 1,511 columns. DEVIATION from signed gate: external = 8.1% vs ~30% — column-yield per table (~12) is the constraint; ~40 tables needed for 30%. Surfaced to author for blessing; more tables is the crank if ac-07 shows a GitTables/external gap. Next: ac-03 three-lens pre-labeller.

ac-03 complete 2026-06-10: scripts/gold_lens_prelabel.py labels all 1,271 non-anchor candidates with three independent lenses (value predicates incl. isbn checksums + written-format discipline; header vocab; reference membership — ISO 3166, IANA TLDs, GeoNames cities15000/admin1 as LENS-ONLY corroboration per the decisive-lens rule). Consensus = noisy-or combined confidence >=0.85 across >=2 agreeing lenses with >=1 non-reference voter, plus value-alone consensus ONLY for definitional integer/decimal at >=0.95. Result: 349 consensus (27%), 922 queue. scripts/gold_queue_prioritise.py ranks the queue to the author's 350-column budget (tier1 round-robin caps, disagreement-first, external boosted); 572 rows -> gold_unreviewed_backlog.tsv (candidates, NOT gold; future sittings promote). Author sitting file: eval/gold/gold_review_queue_v1_review.csv (350 rows, values + lens votes + proposed_label + blank human_verdict; secret-scan clean). Gold v1 on completion = 240 anchor + 349 consensus + <=350 adjudicated ~= 939 verified columns. Next: ac-05 leakage firewall + ac-06 scorer (agent work, parallel to the author's sitting).

ac-06 complete 2026-06-10: score_gold_anchor.py extended (no parallel scorer) — build-gold merges anchor+consensus+adjudications into eval/gold/gold_corpus_v1.tsv (re-run as verdicts land); predict gains vendored-CSV fallback for external columns; score gains Wilson CIs, global per-label metrics (cross-family FPs count), and a single headline. FIRST VERIFIED BASELINE: v19 = 404/589 = 0.686 accuracy (CI 0.647-0.722) on gold v1 (240 anchor + 349 consensus). Stories: postal_code precision 0.074 (25 FP — worst over-emitter measured), alphanumeric_id recall 0.128, integer recall 0.390 (contested-strata absorption), coordinates/dates/decimals hold at P=1.0. utc support=1 — the positive-scarcity is now measured fact. Caveats in baseline_v19.md (consensus labels pending author spot-validation; truncated-sample path; by-design selection bias). output/gold-corpus/baseline_v19.md committed.

ac-04 progress 2026-06-10 (author-approved variation): author requested subagent adjudication of the 350-row queue. Two independent panels (4 agents each; panel B prompted as skeptic starting from refute-the-proposal) judged every row blind. Result: 326/350 (93%) double-confirmed -> status llm-adjudicated in eval/gold/gold_review_queue_v1_llm.tsv; of those, 220 CONFIRM the lens proposal and 106 OVERTURN it (incl. systematic finds: tz-name columns -> datetime.offset.iana, timestamps-with-time vs date-only keys, US state codes vs country codes, full addresses vs city, iata/icao codes, numeric_code for leading-zero codes, hostname for bare domains, company names -> entity_name). 24 rows stay open (11 panel splits, 13 unsure). Provenance: panel transcripts at output/gold-corpus/adjudication/. GUARD: llm verdicts are a SEPARATE provenance tier, NOT yet merged into gold — author spot-check pending (eval/gold/gold_spotcheck_author.csv, 40 rows: 25 overturns + 15 confirms, deterministic md5 pick). Acceptance decision (whether/how llm tier enters gold v1) is the author's; it amends the ac-04 human-adjudication design. Agents also surfaced taxonomy gaps: no DMY-slash-with-seconds key, no ISO-timestamp-without-Z key, no tz-abbreviation key, no numeric-month key.

llm tier ACCEPTED 2026-06-10: author spot-check 40/40 ok (Wilson 95% lower bound on panel-author agreement >=0.91). build-gold merges the tier (40 rows author-grade, 286 llm-adjudicated-2panel). Gold v1 = 915 columns; v19 re-baseline = 606/915 = 0.662 (CI 0.631-0.692). New measured families: state_code P=R=0 (unhandled), categorical recall 0.390 (s=100), city over-emit P=0.667/R=1.0. Remaining for ac-04 completion: 24 open queue rows (splits/unsures) + fold-in of the 120-row rare-type scoreboard sample (task t-0001692818b74c8d50b76340).

ac-04 COMPLETE 2026-06-10: 350-row queue fully dispositioned (326 llm-2panel author-accepted, 16 author-resolved, 8 skips) AND the 120-row scoreboard sample folded in — 195 rows two-panel verified at 195/195 agreement: 193 assertions hold, 2 url hard-negatives overturned (protocol-relative links ARE urls). Scoreboard gold logic validated at 99.0% (output/eval-ceiling-diagnosis/scoreboard_canonicalisation.md); task t-0001692818b74c8d50b76340 closed — choice 0093's GO-precision caveat closes at sample level. Refinement queued: //-prefixed values count as url-positive.
